name: GEOG 4000W
title: Capstone Seminar in Geography
description: Techniques for, and practice in, research, writing, citation, and data presentation in geography.
requirement_description: ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011; open to junior or higher Geography or Geographic Information Science majors, others by instructor consent. Prerequisite or corequisite: One Geography course at the 3000 level or higher.
